top_categories.workout_context: Road-specific control matters at Granfondo Novi Sad. Practice on rolling hills: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 62 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Granfondo Novi Sad's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before June.
When someone attacks on rolling hills, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
79ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
At Granfondo Novi Sad, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Granfondo Novi Sad. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Granfondo Novi Sad. Train it until it feels boring.
62 miles on rolling hills burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on rolling hills can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.
Varied gradients on rolling hills demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 4,921ft of climbing on rolling hills does to your power file on race day.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.

race_overlay.weather: June in Novi Sad, Serbia — Early June: typically 15-25°C (59-77°F), mild but variable. Rehearse adaptable layers and race-day kit changes in the final 2 weeks before Granfondo Novi Sad. Use the organizer's current forecast and safety instructions for final choices.
race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for Granfondo Novi Sad's 62 miles. Start early and use products you tolerate. The organizer has not published a reliable resupply plan, so rehearse a self-sufficient carry and revise it when the rider document is released.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at Granfondo Novi Sad. Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at Granfondo Novi Sad rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on rolling hills to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Road Specific, Race Simulation, and VO2max to prepare you for 62 miles of rolling hills in Novi Sad, Serbia.
